protocols.PROTOCOL.md:
# R25 explicit replay state-data reset diagnostic

Preregistered before model runs: hypothesis that metadata-only clear after warmup contributes to R23 variability. Add helper-only MOE_REPLAY_CLEAR_DATA=1, default/0/empty retain false. Do not patch engine or baseline checkout. Original7fe engine with new helper built against original headers/six frozen original libraries; current candidate79c7778 with matched helper. Source/libraries/compiler/cache/commands/model/workload frozen; same3107+128 tokens/context8192/b512/ub512/ngl99/ncmoe18/t8/tb8/FAon/Q8KV/fitOFF/mmap. No callbacks or profilers.

Two fresh processes each of original/candidate, order BASE_CLEAR/CLEAR/CLEAR/BASE_CLEAR, one internal warmup and one measured raw capture. Both warmup and repetition perform clear_data=true. Finite/nonzero each135vocab248320 vectors, compare every endpoint/raw; bit equality required for all four to pass. Separately inspect initialization markers, invalid option rejected before load, 0/empty OFF parse behavior. If any pair differs the reset hypothesis is insufficient; no speed ranking/default change/fix claim. Earlier false-clear R23 captures remain external controls with their actual helpers/builds, not pooled samples.

Memory clearing remains outside existing per-evaluation timers; this is correctness diagnosis, not free reset or application latency. It uses existing synchronous buffer-clear API; no inference math change. Safety scope24G/swap2G/floor6GiB/timeout600s/2Hz, one model process at a time, unchanged GPU settings. Root cause is not established merely by a matching instrumented/reset path.
protocols.CONDITIONAL-CONTROL-PROTOCOL.md: Recorded 2026-10-06T23:57:57.576291+00:00: if all four clear_data=true outputs match, collect two additional original-engine false-clear captures using the SAME new helper and original libraries, before attributing a change to clearing. If true-clear outputs differ, no speed or false-clear extension is needed to conclude that true clearing is insufficient. This conditional extension was recorded without reading the pending first capture result. Earlier R23 controls remain archived, not substituted for matched-helper controls.
protocols.DEFAULT-CONTROL-PROTOCOL.md: Declared before the short control runs: verify the NEW helper with absent,0,empty MOE_REPLAY_CLEAR_DATA on the original finite-checked244+128 tokens. One fresh candidate process per option, warmup+one raw repetition, same brief c1024/b512/ub512/ncmoe18/t8/tb8/Q8KV/FAon/fitOFF/mmap and frozen79c helper/libraries. All raw dumps must be finite/nonzero and byte-exact canonical B1 SHA b7bb28a. This is default compatibility, not three independent speed samples. After the long diagnostic ends, run separately; do not overlap model processes. Invalid option2 must reject before loading;0/empty must pass option parsing, tested against deliberately absent model path as non-model launches.

analysis.status: helper/default compatibility validated; clear_data=true insufficient for long original repeatability
analysis.limits: No speed ranking. Reset outside inference call timers. Candidate two matching captures do not override failed original pair or establish general determinism. No causal attribution from old false-clear vs new true-clear captures. Conditional matched-helper false extension not triggered because true gate failed.
